new = '''    # Metadata calls can contain dictionaries/arrays with nested parentheses,\n    # so scan for the matching delimiter instead of using a non-greedy regex.\n    start = 0\n    while True:\n        mm = re.search(r"#metadata\\s*\\(", src[start:])\n        if not mm:\n            break\n        open_pos = start + mm.end() - 1\n        depth = 0\n        close_pos = None\n        in_str = False\n        esc = False\n        for j in range(open_pos, len(src)):\n            ch = src[j]\n            if in_str:\n                if esc:\n                    esc = False\n                elif ch == "\\\\":\n                    esc = True\n                elif ch == '\"':\n                    in_str = False\n                continue\n            if ch == '\"':\n                in_str = True\n            elif ch == '(':\n                depth += 1\n            elif ch == ')':\n                depth -= 1\n                if depth == 0:\n                    close_pos = j\n                    break\n        if close_pos is None:\n            break\n        inner = src[open_pos + 1:close_pos].strip()\n        rest = src[close_pos + 1: close_pos + 80]\n        lm = re.match(r"\\s*(<[^>]+>)", rest)\n        val: Any = inner\n        try:\n            val = eval_expr(inner)\n        except Exception:\n            pass\n        elem = {"func": "metadata", "value": normalize_for_json(val)}\n        if lm:\n            elem["label"] = lm.group(1)\n        elements.append(elem)\n        start = close_pos + 1\n    return elements\n'''
